from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialAssetRecord(BaseModel):
    """A specific financial asset item extracted from a single document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company the report belongs to")
    asset_item_name: str | None = Field(description="The specific line item name, e.g. '使用权资产'")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numerical value of the asset")
    balance_type: str | None = Field(description="Whether this is the start or end of period balance, e.g. '期末余额', '期初余额'")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The time period the report covers, e.g. '2024 Q1'")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit, e.g. '元'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    asset_records: list[FinancialAssetRecord]
